message.content: Added `part filter : FuelFilter` to Vehicle and replaced the direct tank→engine connection with `tank.fuelOut to filter.inlet` and `filter.outlet to engine.fuelIn`. To make the first connection valid, I retyped `FuelFilter::inlet` from `LegacyFuelPort` to `FuelPort` (approved by you); no definitions were deleted, and the model has no remaining errors.
